protocol.refinement: Around the feasible coarse winner, test its +/-5 and +/-10 seconds not already tested, bounded by 0..600. If a feasible winner reaches the maximum coarse gap, extend by 15/30 seconds before refinement.
protocol.selection: Among rows whose latest individual return in every screening round is <=13:00, minimize mean queue time, then mean complete time, then slot seconds. Preserve unconstrained minimum separately.
protocol.numericMeaning: Minutes after 11:20; 11:50 common allowed start, 13:00 example return target. 1610 people and capacities are scenario parameters, not field observations.
